name: Carnufex
sum: Carnufex is an early crocodylomorph from the Late Triassic Pekin Formation of North Carolina, estimated at about 3 m long and described as a top predator.
wsnote: About 3 m long based on the holotype (Wikipedia).
holotype: NCSM 21558, a partial skull and skeleton (premaxilla, maxilla, lacrimal, jugal, parts of the jaw, atlas intercentrum, neural arches, ribs and a humerus).
material: The holotype and a referred humerus, NCSM 21623, from the same level.
biology: Its describers presented it as an early crocodylomorph that added to the diversity of top predators in its ecosystem.
author: Zanno et al. 2015
